title: Dunn, Alleged Member Of The Central Committee Of The Chinese Communist Party

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35m-59-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Kildare No. B. REGISTRY.
SECTION 2 D
REPORT
Date November 16, 1933

Subject (in full) Dunn, alleged member of the Central Committee of the Chinese
Communist Party.
Made by D.S.Prokofiev. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached translation of ex-
tract from French Police Intelligence Report dated October 20,
1933, containing V.A.Morison's statement on the subject of " Finan-
cial and material support for Chinese Red Armies", I have to
state that no information is available as to the identity of the
individual named Dunn who, according to Morison, is a representa-
tive of the Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party
maintaining contact with the local Soviet agents. Morison defini-
tely states that Dunn is a Chinese, but he is unable or unwilling
to furnish any information which could lead to the establishment
of Dunn's identity.

It is possible that the name " Dunn " is an incor-
rectly romanized Chinese name. In this connection it is of inte-
rest to note that one Dung Tsoong Hsiu ( 中 夏 ) alias
Dung An Zah (鄧 安 石 ), member of the Central Committee of the
Chinese Communist Party in 1924-5, was mentioned in the statement
of Chiang Vee Sing in December 1932 ( Shooting Affray at No 1040
S Vung Lee, off Tatung Road, File D-4257).

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
[Signature]
Please file
[Signature]
17/12

报告
日期：1933年11月16日

主题（全称）：邓恩（Dunn），据称为中国共产党中央委员会成员。
制作人：D.S.普罗科菲耶夫。转呈人 [签名]

关于附上的1933年10月20日法国警察情报报告摘录的译文，其中包含 V.A.莫里森（V.A.Morison）就“对中国红军的财政和物资支持”一题所作的陈述，本人须声明，目前尚无关于名为邓恩（Dunn）之人的身份信息。据莫里森称，此人是中国共产党中央委员会的代表，负责与当地苏维埃特工保持联系。莫里森明确指出邓恩是中国人，但他无法或不愿提供任何有助于确定邓恩身份的信息。

“邓恩”这个名字可能是一个罗马化拼写错误的中文姓名。在此方面，值得注意的是，在1932年12月蒋维新（Chiang Vee Sing，音译）的供词中（大通路旁宋云里1040号枪击案，档案号 D-4257），曾提及邓中夏（Dung Tsoong Hsiu），别名邓安石（Dung An Zah），系1924-5年间中国共产党中央委员会成员。

G. 普罗科菲耶夫
D.S.

特别科科长。

EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.

October 20, 1933.

Financial and Material Support for Chinese Red Armies.

The following is a translation of the second
report submitted by V. A. Morrison, a former employee of the
local Branch of Centrosojus, to the Chinese Military
authorities:-

In compliance with a decision of the Bureau of
Finance of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of
the U.S.S.R. made on October 26, 1931 on the subject of
work in foreign countries, all funds for the support of
communist organizations in countries of the Far East (China,
Japan and Korea) are to be transferred, not by certain
trustworthy firms as had been done hitherto, but direct to
the representatives of the Chinese communist organizations.

This new system has been applied to China since
the end of 1932. The great lapse of time between the date
of the decision of the Central Committee of the Communist
Party of the U.S.S.R. and the date of its enforcement is due
to the fact that the Chinese communist organizations, such
as the Chinese Communist Party in the sovietized regions
have not been able to nominate, within the time designated,
the representatives to whom more or less large sums of
money might be entrusted. The delay in the selection of
representatives by the Chinese communist organizations
was due to the fact that the decision of the Bureau of
Finance of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of
the U.S.S.R. stipulates that all responsibility for the
remittance of funds to their destination shall fall
directly on the secretary-general of the Chinese Communist
Party. This condition is being insisted upon owing to
the fact that a certain sum of money destined for the
Japanese Communist Party and which was to have been remitted
by a trustworthy person----a Japanese----had been

1933年10月20日。

对中国红军的财政和物资支持。

以下是前苏联消费合作社中央联社（Centrosojus）上海分社前雇员 V. A. 莫里森向中国军方当局提交的第二份报告的译文：

根据苏联共产党中央委员会财政局于1931年10月26日就国外工作问题作出的决定，所有用于支持远东国家（中国、日本和朝鲜）共产主义组织的资金，不再像以往那样通过某些可信的公司转移，而是直接转给中国共产主义组织的代表。

这一新制度自1932年底起在中国实施。苏联共产党中央委员会作出决定的日期与其执行日期之间存在巨大的时间差，原因是中国的共产主义组织，如苏维埃地区的中国共产党，未能在指定时间内提名出可以托付或多或少的巨额资金的代表。中国共产主义组织在挑选代表方面的延误，是由于苏联共产党中央委员会财政局的决定规定，将资金汇至目的地的全部责任直接由中国共产党总书记承担。坚持这一条件是因为有一笔 destined for 日本共产党的款项，本应由一名可信人士——一名日本人——汇款，但该款项已被

misappropriated by the man who later sought refuge in the
Philippine Islands.
Early in the month of April, a sum made up of gold
&38,000, Mex. $45,000 and Yen 25,000 was remitted to the Chinese
Communist Party through the intermediary of N. F. Mikhailoff,
a representative of Centrosojus. The largest portion of this
money was destined for the "red" regions in China. N. F.
Mikhailoff proceeded to Tientsin early in April for this
purpose. The official object of his journey was to attend to
the sale of a stock of U.S.S.R. cotton thread. Shortly before
the voyage of Mikhailoff to Tientsin, a person named Sereguine,
manager of the Tientsin branch of Centrosojus, arrived in
Shanghai (February, 1933) to inform him that the representatives
of the Chinese soviet regions were expected at Tientsin early
in April. Another person named Saneguine, an employee of the
local Branch of Centrosojus, was sent to Tientsin early in
April to secure information from the Chinese about the amount
they required. The object of his journey was at that time
stated to be the sale of U.S.S.R. textile products.
Upon his arrival in Shanghai, Sereguine stated that
an interview could be arranged with the representative of the
Chinese Communist Party at Tientsin in the premises of the
Chihli Trading Co., a firm which is owrking for the sale of
U.S.S.R. textile products, but after the journey to Tientsin,
it was found that an interview could be held only at the
office of the branch of Centrosojus. It was at this place
where Mikhailoff actually met the Chinese communists in
question and handed to them the amounts indicated above.
It is to be noted that in addition to the sums remitted to the
representatives of the Chinese Communist Party by Mikhailoff,
Saneguine also handed to them a sum of Mex. $25,000.
75% of the amounts handed to the Chinese by
Saneguine as well as by Mikhailoff consisted of forged bank-
notes of the Bank of Communications. These banknotes had been
imported into Shanghai on board a soviet steamer which
page_data.zh:
-2-

后来逃往菲律宾群岛的那个人侵吞。
4月初，一笔由黄金38,000美元、墨西哥银元45,000元和日元25,000元组成的款项，通过苏联消费合作社中央联社代表 N. F. 米哈伊洛夫（N. F. Mikhailoff）作为中介，汇给了中国共产党。这笔钱的大部分是 destined for 中国的“红色”地区。为此，N. F. 米哈伊洛夫于4月初前往天津。他此次行程的官方目的是处理一批苏联棉纱的销售事宜。在米哈伊洛夫前往天津前不久，苏联消费合作社中央联社天津分社经理谢列吉内（Sereguine）于1933年2月抵达上海，告知他预计中国苏维埃地区的代表将于4月初到达天津。另一名名为萨内吉内（Saneguine）的人，系苏联消费合作社中央联社上海分社雇员，也于4月初被派往天津，以从中国人那里获取他们所需金额的信息。当时声称他此行的目的是销售苏联纺织品。
谢列吉内抵达上海后表示，可以在直隶贸易公司（Chihli Trading Co.）安排与中国共产党在天津的代表会面，该公司从事苏联纺织品的销售工作，但在前往天津后发现，会面只能在苏联消费合作社中央联社分社的办公室进行。正是在这个地方，米哈伊洛夫实际会见了上述中国共产党人，并将上述金额交给他们。值得注意的是，除了米哈伊洛夫交给中国共产党代表的款项外，萨内吉内也交给了他们墨西哥银元25,000元。
萨内吉内和米哈伊洛夫交给中国人的款项中，75%是由伪造的交通银行钞票组成。这些钞票是由一艘苏联轮船于1933年2月运载苏联石油抵达上海时带入上海的。

arrived in Shanghai with a cargo of U.S.S.R. petroleum
in February, 1933.
It seems that Mikhailoff did not hand the full
amount of gold $38,000 to the representative of the Chinese
Communist Party because he did not want to arouse suspicion
through the appearance of such a large amount of American
dollars in the soviet regions. About gold $15,000 ( all
counterfeit) were taken back to Shanghai by Mikhailoff and
handed to the deputy manager of the local branch of the
Dalbanque in the name of Tzaloohoff ( Tseloukhoff).
This last named is the special agent for the distribution of
money destined for secret work in China. In 1932, this man
made a voyage to Moscow to formulate a planfor the
distribution of secret funds for the year 1933.
At about the same time, money was remitted to the
Central Committee of the Shanghai Branch of the Chinese
Communist Party. This took place not long after the
arrival in Shanghai of Waldmann, representative of the
Vnechtorg ( foreign commerce of the U.S.S.R.). This
person was formerly a procurator of Moscow who is at present
directing, for the time being, the Japanese and Korean
Sections of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of
the U.S.S.R.
A conference, for this purpose, was held with a
representative of the local Branch of the Chinese Communist
Party ( in March, 1933) in house No. 47 Rue Amiral Courbet.
At this conference, were present M. Markoff, manager of the
local Branch of Centrosojus, Morrison (who was, at this time,
manager of the Chemical Department of this establishment),
Tzaloohoff ( Dalbanque) and a person named Dunn, the
representative of the Central Committee of the Chinese
Communist Party. Waldmann gave Dunn certain instructions
on the policy to be followed by the Chinese Communist Party
as a result of the Sino-Japanese conflict and in view of
the possibility of a conflict between the U.S.S.R. and
page_data.zh:
-3-
看来，米哈伊洛夫并没有将全部38,000黄金美元交给中国共产党代表，因为他不想因在苏维埃地区出现如此大量的美元而引起怀疑。约15,000黄金美元（全部为假币）由米哈伊洛夫带回上海，并以查洛霍夫（Tzaloohoff，即 Tseloukhoff）的名义交给了道胜银行（Dalbanque）上海分行的副经理。这最后提到的人是负责分配用于在中国进行秘密工作的资金的特别特工。1932年，此人曾前往莫斯科，制定1933年秘密资金的分配计划。
大约在同一时间，资金被汇给了中国共产党上海支部中央委员会。此事发生在苏联对外贸易人民委员部（Vnechtorg，即苏联对外贸易）代表瓦尔德曼（Waldmann）抵达上海后不久。此人曾是莫斯科的检察官，目前暂时负责领导苏联共产党中央委员会的日本部和朝鲜部。
为此，于1933年3月在库尔贝海军上将路47号举行了一次会议，与会者包括中国共产党上海地方支部的一名代表。出席这次会议的有：苏联消费合作社中央联社上海分社经理 M. 马尔科夫（M. Markoff）、莫里森（当时是该机构化学部经理）、查洛霍夫（道胜银行）以及一名名为邓恩（Dunn）的人，他是中国共产党中央委员会的代表。瓦尔德曼就中日冲突以及苏联与

page_data.en:
-4-

Japan. Waldmann added that he would proceed to Tientsin
to issue instructions.
At the close of the meeting, Tzaloohoff, on the
orders of Waldmann, handed Dunn a sum of Mex. $12,000
and Yen 15,000. The official reason for this meeting
was given out as the opening of negotiations for the
sale of the products of the Soyuzneft.
After the return of Waldmann to Tientsin, he
had another meeting with Markoff, Tzaloohoff, Morrison
and a Chinese named Kai Ho who works in the economics
department of the local Branch of Centrosojus and who
speaks Russian. ( This Chinese is short and thin and
looks like a Japanese). Little was discussed at
this meeting: it was simply pointed out that the work
done at Tientsin was insufficient. There was a
shortage of funds and large sums were required for the
intensification of the propaganda in this city.
Waldmann promised to bring forward this question upon
his return to Moscow.
At the close of the meeting, everybody left the
house except Waldmann who had a private conversation
with the Chinese Kai Ho.
page_data.zh:
-4-

日本之间可能发生冲突的情况下，中国共产党应遵循的政策向邓恩发出了某些指示。瓦尔德曼补充说，他将前往天津发布指示。
会议结束时，查洛霍夫奉瓦尔德曼之命，交给邓恩墨西哥银元12,000元和日元15,000元。这次会议的官方理由被宣称是为了开启销售苏联石油联合公司（Soyuzneft）产品的谈判。
瓦尔德曼返回天津后，他又与马尔科夫、查洛霍夫、莫里森以及一名在苏联消费合作社中央联社上海分社经济部工作、会说俄语的中国人凯霍（Kai Ho，音译）举行了另一次会议。（这名中国人身材矮小瘦削，看起来像日本人）。这次会议讨论的内容很少：只是指出在天津所做的工作不足。资金短缺，需要大量资金来加强在该市的宣传工作。瓦尔德曼承诺在返回莫斯科时提出这个问题。
会议结束时，除瓦尔德曼外，所有人都离开了房子，瓦尔德曼与中国人凯霍进行了私下谈话。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGI
No. D
Date

November 23 33.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge your
letter No. 3403 dated November 15, 1933, and to
state that there is nothing in the police records
against Miss Luba Minger who desires to travel
through Netherlands India to Great Britain.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

谨此确认收到您1933年11月15日的第3403号来信，并声明警方记录中没有任何不利于鲁巴·明格（Luba Minger）小姐的记录，她希望经由荷属东印度前往英国。

谨此致意，
